physics.classConcept: Photoelectric effect: work function Φ₀ = hν₀, Einstein photoelectric equation K_max = hν - Φ₀ = eV₀, stopping potential vs frequency graphs (slope = h/e); de Broglie hypothesis λ = h/p = h/mv = 1.227/√V nm for electrons; Atoms: Rutherford model, Bohr postulates for hydrogen-like species (radius r_n = 0.529 n²/Z Å, velocity v_n = 2.18×10⁶ Z/n m/s, energy E_n = -13.6 Z²/n² eV), hydrogen spectral series (Lyman UV, Balmer visible, Paschen IR, Rydberg formula 1/λ = R Z²(1/n1² - 1/n2²)); Nuclei: nuclear radius R = R₀ A^(1/3), nuclear density constant ~2.3×10¹⁷ kg/m³, mass defect Δm, binding energy BE = Δm × 931.5 MeV, binding energy per nucleon curve (peak at Fe-56 8.75 MeV/nucleon), nuclear fission (U-235 chain reaction) and nuclear fusion (proton-proton cycle in sun)

Diener, free RNA without protein coat, potato spindle tuber), Prions, Lichens; Plant Kingdom: Algae (Chlorophyceae starch, Phaeophyceae fucoxanthin/algin, Rhodophyceae r-phycoerythrin/agar), Bryophytes (amphibians of plant kingdom, liverworts vs mosses protonema), Pteridophytes (vascular, heterospory Selaginella/Salvinia precursor to seed habit), Gymnosperms (naked seeds, mycorrhiza Pinus, coralloid roots Cycas), Angiosperms; Animal Kingdom: non-chordates (Porifera choanocytes, Cnidaria cnidoblasts/metagenesis Obelia, Ctenophora bioluminescence/comb plates, Platyhelminthes flame cells/flatworms, Aschelminthes pseudocoelomate, Annelida metamerism/nephridia, Arthropoda largest phylum/chitinous exoskeleton/Malpighian tubules, Mollusca 2nd largest/radula, Echinodermata water vascular system/radial adult, Hemichordata proboscis gland) and Chordata (Cyclostomes, Chondrichthyes placoid scales/cartilaginous, Osteichthyes cycloid scales/operculum/air bladder, Amphibia, Reptilia 3-chambered heart except crocodile 4, Aves pneumatic bones, Mammalia mammary glands)
